conventions: Each case is one subtitle file ("input") parsed as "format". expected.cue_count is the exact number of cues; expected.cues lists the checked cues by output "index"; a field absent from a cue is not checked. Times are in milliseconds. plain_text never contains tags, {...} override blocks or HTML tags; the lines of a cue are separated by a single "\n" (SRT/VTT line breaks, ASS \N and \n); ASS \h is U+00A0. SRT blocks without an index line are accepted. Cues are sorted by start time (stable); ASS cues by start, then layer, then file order; overlapping cues are kept. spans lists the styled runs a case checks: "text" is the exact substring of plain_text the run covers, with the style values checked over it (bold, italic, underline: booleans; color: "#RRGGBB"; size: the ASS \fs value; font: name); an empty list means the cue has no styled runs; no "spans" means styling is not checked. anchor is the numpad code 1-9 from ASS \an or the style Alignment. pos is \pos divided by PlayResX/PlayResY. play_res is [PlayResX, PlayResY], default [384, 288] when absent. Post-1.0 ASS features (SUB-019) and overrides outside the SUB-003 list are ignored without error and the text is kept; drawing commands (\p1...) never enter plain_text and a drawing-only event produces no cue. Audiobook-only fields are ignored. "divergence" marks an intentional difference from Fushi (fushi_expected is what Fushi expects); "skip" marks a case that checks only post-1.0, audiobook-only or non-parsing behaviour (the input and expected of a non-parsing case are placeholders). parseSubtitleMarkup inputs are wrapped into a minimal ASS file (see each case note). A span value of null means the property is not set inline (no colour, no font).
